full_prompt_en: A square impressionistic oil painting shows a broad rain-soaked city boulevard beneath a cloudy gray sky. The view looks down the road toward a distant hazy row of buildings. At the left, old stone facades and a tower rise behind dark autumn trees, with small shop awnings and clusters of pedestrians along the sidewalk. Near the middle of the street, a dark horse-drawn carriage moves away through the wet roadway. A tall ornate lamppost stands slightly right of center, its warm lamps glimmering against the cool air. More people in dark coats and hats cross the shining pavement, their bodies reduced to quick upright marks at a distance. The entire lower half is a mirror of broken reflections: pale sky, black wheels, warm windows, and yellow lamps stretch into irregular vertical streaks over puddles. At the right, trees and a building edge soften into mist. The brushwork is loose and heavily textured, with short dark dabs describing foliage and figures, dragged cream-gray strokes for water, and thicker golden accents for artificial light. The sky is painted in broad soft layers of pearl, slate, and warm cloud gray. Diffuse daylight from above flattens distant forms, while the lamps and storefronts add small warm pools reflected below. The perspective opens from a wide wet foreground into a crowded vanishing point. The overall composition balances the tall left-hand architecture and central lamp against the reflective road, giving the rainy urban scene a bustling but wistful atmosphere.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形印象派油画描绘阴灰天空下宽阔、被雨浸透的城市大道。视线沿道路望向朦胧的远处建筑。左侧，古老石质立面与塔楼升起在深色秋树后，小店遮篷和成群行人沿人行道展开。街道中部附近，一辆深色马车沿湿路远去。略偏右的一根高大华饰路灯立着，暖灯在冷空气中微亮。更多穿深色外套、戴帽的人穿过发亮路面，远处身体化为快速竖笔。整个下半部是破碎倒影：浅色天空、黑车轮、暖窗和黄灯在水洼中拉成不规则竖条。右侧树木和建筑边缘渐入薄雾。笔触松动而厚实，短促深色点笔描出树叶与人物，拖曳的奶油灰笔痕描出水面，较厚金色重点表现人工灯光。天空由珍珠灰、石板灰和暖云灰的宽阔柔和层次绘成。上方漫射日光压平远景形体，路灯和店面则增添小片暖光，并在下方形成反射。透视从宽阔湿润前景收向拥挤消失点。整体构图以左侧高耸建筑和中央路灯平衡反光道路，让雨中的城市既繁忙又有惆怅气息。
style_prompt_en: An impressionistic oil-painted surface uses loose loaded strokes, short dark dabs, and dragged reflective streaks. Pearl gray, slate, muted olive, charcoal, and warm amber form a cool-dominant palette punctuated by small bright accents. Upright dark marks repeat through a broad pale field, while irregular vertical reflections stretch across the foreground. Edges soften with atmospheric haze in the distance and sharpen in selected near details. Diffuse overhead light lowers contrast across large areas; compact warm highlights create points of focus and echo below. The surface is tactile and wet-looking, with thick dabs against thin blended passages. A wide open lower plane leads into a denser upper band, producing a lively but wistful spatial rhythm.
style_prompt_zh: 印象派油画表面使用松动厚笔、短促深色点笔和拖曳反光线条。珍珠灰、石板灰、低饱和橄榄色、炭色与暖琥珀色构成冷色占优、点缀少量亮色的色域。深色竖笔在宽阔浅色域中重复，不规则纵向倒影延伸过前景。远处边缘被大气薄雾柔化，少数近处细节则变清晰。上方漫射光降低大片区域对比，紧凑暖亮点形成焦点并在下方呼应。表面有触感和湿润感，厚点笔与薄融合色段相对。宽敞下方平面通向更密集的上方带状区域，形成活跃而惆怅的空间节奏。
theme_en: A rainy city boulevard with a carriage and glowing lamps
theme_zh: 雨中有马车与暖灯的城市大道
name: Antoine Blanchard
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
